title: tld repo-admin policy
description: The desired state of a GitHub organisation and its repositories, read by scripts/repo_admin.py. A section that is absent means 'not managed'.

org.description: The GitHub organisation this policy governs.

repos.description: Which repositories of the organisation the repository-level checks cover.

exclude.description: Repository name globs to leave out.

org_settings.description: Organisation settings. All but two_factor_requirement_enabled are changed through PATCH /orgs/{org}; that one can only be read, so a difference is reported.

members.description: Who is in the organisation. Reported only; the script never adds or removes people.

max_owners.description: Report when the organisation has more owners.

require_two_factor.description: Report members who have two-factor authentication disabled.

apps.description: GitHub Apps installed on the organisation. GitHub exposes no last-used time for an app, so the check compares with an allow list.

allow.description: App slugs that may be installed. Any other installed app is reported.

fine_grained.description: Fine-grained personal access tokens that were granted access to the organisation.

max_unused_days.description: Revoke a token not used for this many days (a never-used token counts from the day access was granted).

branch_protection.description: Protection of one branch. Added where the branch has neither a protection rule nor an active ruleset; an existing rule that differs is reported, never replaced.

branch.description: A branch name, or the word default (the repository's default branch). Default: default.

require_status_checks.description: Names of the checks that must pass.

strict.description: Require the branch to be up to date before merging (with require_status_checks). Default false.

secrets.description: Actions and Dependabot secrets, by name (values can never be read).

required.description: Secrets every selected repository must have, as its own or from the organisation. A missing one is reported.

delete_unused.description: Delete a secret no workflow refers to. Default false: report only.
Delete a variable no workflow refers to. Default false: report only.

sync.description: Labels every selected repository must have.

aliases.description: Old names, renamed to this one so issues keep the label.

keep.description: Labels outside sync that are left alone.

delete_unused.description: Delete a label that is not in sync and is on no issue or pull request.

delete_unlisted.description: Delete every label not in sync or keep, even one in use.

webhooks.description: Repository and organisation webhooks. Delivery URLs are shown with their path removed.

delete.description: Delete a hook that is switched off (inactive) or whose last delivery failed (failing). Empty or absent: report only.

keep_urls.description: Hooks whose URL starts with one of these are never reported.

max_unused_days.description: Report a key not used for this many days (never used: counted from creation).

delete_unused.description: Delete such a key. Default false.

branches.description: Branches already merged into the default branch.

delete_merged.description: Delete a branch whose every commit is in the default branch, that has no open pull request and is not protected. Default false: report only.

min_age_days.description: Only branches whose last commit is older than this. Default 14; it keeps a branch that was just cut and has no commit of its own.

keep.description: Branch name globs never reported, for example release/*.

config_dirs.description: Files and directories committed to the repositories.

forbid.description: Paths or globs (root-relative) that must not exist, for example .archon. * matches within one path segment. Removed through a pull request.

require.description: Files every repository must have, as root-relative paths (for example SECURITY.md, .github/CODEOWNERS, LICENSE). A missing one is reported.

known.description: Top-level dot directories that are expected, in addition to the built-in list (.github .claude .tld .devcontainer .vscode .husky .config .changeset .githooks). Any other is reported.

workflow_lint.description: Read-only hygiene checks on the workflow files of the default branch. Nothing is changed: a finding says what to fix by hand.

pin_actions.description: Report actions not pinned to a full commit SHA: third_party leaves actions/* and github/* alone, all reports every one.

require_permissions.description: Report a workflow without a top-level permissions block.

forbid_pull_request_target.description: Report a workflow that runs on pull_request_target.

workflows.description: Workflow files to install, keep up to date or remove, through a pull request.

path.description: A template file of your own, below the directory of the policy file (no absolute path, no ..).

dest.description: Where it goes. Default: .github/workflows/ plus the template's file name.

params.description: Values for the template's __UPPER_CASE__ placeholders, as strings of letters, digits and . _ / -. main_branch defaults to the repository's default branch.

repos.description: Repository name globs this entry applies to. Default: all selected.

remove.description: Delete the destination file instead of installing it.
